meanings.definition: Great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective.
examples: Dr. Rieux worked with tireless zeal to organize the emergency medical brigades.

meanings.definition: A person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of their religious, political, or other ideals.
examples: Father Paneloux spoke with the fiery conviction of an Old Testament zealot.

meanings.definition: The time at which something is most powerful or successful; the highest point reached by a celestial or other object.
examples: The epidemic reached its catastrophic zenith in the stifling heat of mid-August.
